interaction_definition: t0 Euclidean proximity, self excluded; all present eligible-type context neighbors; target=unchanged supervision mask; all 4 radii; directed target-neighbor statistics and unique unordered pairs/windows reported separately
readiness_rule: Stage3A freeze verified; finite final motion metrics; five-validation convergence criterion reached; original practical vehicle overall/moving FDE retention guard<=25%; without tuning any experiment to this rule
figure_motion_success_failure: class-wise lowest/highest minFDE among full-horizon motion targets, distinct instances; vehicle t0 moving and displacement>5m; pedestrian/bicycle>5m
